description: Debris Segmentation Model using Post-Hurricane Aerial Imagery (CLIPSeg-debris) is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "software", published or maintained by Jamie Padgett, Rice University (rice.edu). This repository provides the primary implementation associated with the paper “Debris segmentation using post-hurricane aerial imagery” (2025). It includes the main model configuration, Python scripts for training and evaluation, and the prompt-based segmentation procedures and baseline comparisons used in the study. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "software" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-yt43-hw55. Keywords: Hurricane,  Debris, Segmentation, Foundation Model. Published 2025-12-02. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 3-Clause BSD License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
